description.value: Trois longues années se sont écoulées depuis l'accident qui a failli laisser Kay Fennel, célèbre chanteuse anglaise, paralysée à vie. Trois années de souffrance et d'angoisse au cours desquelles il lui a fallu réapprendre à marcher, à chanter et à vivre. Trois années pour oublier, surtout, le douloureux souvenir d'un mari qui n'a pas hésité à la quitter pour une autre femme alors qu'elle se trouvait sur un lit d'hôpital. Mais, tandis qu'elle s'apprête à renouer le fil brisé de sa carrière en effectuant sur scène son grand retour, voilà qu'Adam Carmichael surgit de nouveau dans sa vie, bien décidé apparemment à reformer avec elle ce duo que les foules naguère admiraient. Et Kay, à son grand désespoir, découvre qu'elle aura bien du mal à empêcher ce charmeur, aussi résolu qu'imprévisible, de reprendre dans sa vie la place abandonnée.

description.value:
Can one passionate night men a marriage?

Luc Sarrazin's marriage to Star Rouseel was hasty and brief. They separated almost immediately and Star disappeared, but Luc never filed for divorce.

Eighteen months later, Luc tracks Star down -- fearing she's involved in a fraud. When he discovers that Star is the mother of TWINS, he feels doubly deceived!

Luc demands his price: he will have the fraud charge dropped if Star will spend just one last time in his bed. But he's not prepared for the cost of that fleeting taste of passion -- the morning after, he wants more... even to mend their marriage!

first_sentence.value: HE STOOD at the back of the dimly lit, smoke-filled room, unnoticed by the crowd, especially the noisy people clamouring for attention at the bar beside him.

table_of_contents.title: SWEEPING FROM SCOTLAND's UNTAMED HIGHLANDS TO THE TOWER OF LONDON AND WAR-TORN FRANCE... TWO PEOPLE DESTINED TO LOVE IN A DIVIDED LAND.

Danielle D'Aville was the ward of Edward III, sworn to obey the King's order to marry her enemy Adrien MacLachlan, the legendary Scot who masterminded the fall of her beloved home. Suddenly she was the arrogant knight's reluctant wife, pledged to a marriage neither desired. But swept off to his castle in the Scottish highlands, and into his strong embrace, Danielle was soon possessed by a raging passion for the husband she had vowed to despise...

Adrien MacLachlan couldn't afford to trust the emerald-eyed spitfire who carried the blood of French kings in her veins. Danielle's divided loyalties only inflamed the ware that raged between them. Still, he could not control the intense desire his bartered bride inspired, or make her surrender to his will, until he had conquered the headstrong beauty on the battlefield of love....
